description: Canonical registry of DEX pool addresses for the dapp landing-page price strip and the four-vault basket swap routes (issue #482, #556, docs/prd.md§11). The `mainnet` map holds real Base mainnet pool + token addresses; the `devnet` map is the fork-aware override applied when the dapp targets the forked-Base devnet (chain id 918453). On a fresh fork the devnet pools ARE the Base mainnet pools (the genesis ingester copies Base state at the fork block), so the devnet override map points at the same addresses unless a smoke-test stub pool is deployed in their place. Pool addresses MUST NOT be hardcoded in TypeScript — the dapp reads them from this file (acceptance criteria, issue #482). `token0`/`token1` ordering and decimals are recorded so the sqrtPriceX96 -> price conversion is decimals-aware regardless of which token Uniswap assigned to slot 0. `basket_assets` records per-asset token addresses, swap venues (UniswapV3/UniswapV4/Aerodrome), and pool addresses for vault swap routing (issue #556). Pool addresses marked with `pool_status: pending` must be pinned from on-chain verification before the vault can be deployed.
$comment_basket_assets: Basket-vault swap routes (issue #556, docs/prd.md§11.2 ProtocolAssetVault, §11.3 AgentTokenVault, §11.4 RWA vault). Each entry records the asset token address on Base mainnet, the DEX venue (UniswapV3 / UniswapV4 / Aerodrome), pool address, and pool parameter (fee tier for V3/V4 in bps, or 0=volatile/1=stable for Aerodrome). Entries with `pool_status: pending` have a confirmed token address but the pool address must be verified on-chain (Basescan / Aerodrome factory / Uniswap V4 PoolManager) before vault deployment or fork-state snapshot update. The genesis ingester (testing/smoke-test/src/genesis_alloc.rs) must ingest every pool address listed here via testing/ethereum-testnet/config/fork-block.json::ingested_addresses.

Pool address and Aerodrome stable/volatile flag are pending on-chain verification via Aerodrome factory before vault deployment.
